build_gemma2_config: build a Gemma2Config with custom vocab size hidden size and attention heads for model initialization
create_gemma2_rmsnorm: create a Gemma2FastRMSNorm layer by loading weights from a checkpoint using the load class method
run_flash_gemma2_attention: run the FlashGemma2Attention forward pass with hidden states rotary embeddings and kv cache for inference
build_gemma2_mlp: build a Gemma2MLP with fused gate and up projections and a down projection for the feedforward layer
run_flash_gemma2_model: run the FlashGemma2ForCausalLM forward pass with input ids and kv cache to generate logits for text generation
